A1.justification: Local reading tools stalled without returning PDF text or page images; the PDF-skill read also stalled. Although both filenames are identified as versions of the same work, their contents and material completeness could not be verified. This is an evidence-access failure, not evidence of missing document content.

before.justification: No content from v2.pdf could be inspected, so the presence of original empirical results in its main text or appendices remains unverified.

after.justification: No content from v3.pdf could be inspected, so the presence of original empirical results in its main text or appendices remains unverified.

M1.justification: The method descriptions and equations were unavailable for inspection, preventing assessment of changes to the algorithm, architecture, or objectives.

E1.justification: The datasets, tasks, and evaluated scenarios could not be inspected or matched across versions.

E2.justification: The experimental comparisons were unavailable, so comparator membership and changes to evaluated baselines could not be verified.

E3.justification: Evaluation protocols and settings could not be read, preventing assessment of changes to splits, metrics, budgets, or testing procedures.

E4.justification: Neither the main text nor appendices could be inspected for changes to ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and uncertainty reporting were unavailable, so changes in statistical reporting could not be assessed.

E6.justification: Result tables, figures, and passages could not be inspected, preventing verification of numerical or qualitative differences under matched conditions.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs were unavailable for comparison.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions could not be read, so changes in core claims and contributions remain unresolved.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be compared.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures were unavailable, preventing assessment of additions, removals, or revisions.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and reference lists could not be inspected or matched across versions.

P1.justification: No extracted text was available to assess language editing, terminology changes, or document reorganization.

P2.justification: No page images or readable displays were obtained, so changes to figures, tables, captions, and layout could not be assessed.

improvement.justification: The local tool failure prevented inspection of both PDFs, including their appendices. Without before-and-after evidence, no reliable judgment about overall quality improvement or deterioration is possible.
